flows.name: Discover the shop on the landing page
flows.goal: Understand this is the studio's own small-batch shop and start shopping without messaging.

steps.userAction: The buyer opens the shop landing page.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the shop name, that this is the Jaipur studio's own shop for small-batch mugs, bowls, planters and vases, pieces for sale with photos, prices and honest availability, how to order without messaging, a way to browse pieces, and a way for the shop owner to sign in.

steps.userAction: The buyer chooses to browse pieces.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the pieces for sale with photos, prices and availability.

alternatives.condition: No pieces are for sale yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the studio is preparing its next small batch and invites the buyer to check back later; the owner sign-in way remains available.

alternatives.condition: No pieces are for sale yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says there are no pieces for sale yet and invites the buyer to check back later for the next small batch.

flows.outcome: Nothing is stored; the buyer is oriented and can browse pieces, and a refresh shows the same shop front.

flows.name: Browse and view pieces
flows.goal: Find an available piece and judge it without messaging the maker.

steps.userAction: The buyer views the pieces for sale.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows pieces with photos, type, price and availability, with ways to filter by type and availability and to sort by price.

steps.userAction: The buyer filters by type Mug, Bowl, Planter or Vase or by availability and sorts by price.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows only the matching pieces in the chosen price order.

steps.userAction: The buyer opens a piece.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the piece type, price, description, photos, glaze and size options with how many are left per glaze and size, and a clear sold-out state when none are left.

alternatives.condition: No pieces match the chosen filters.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says nothing matches and invites the buyer to clear the filters to see all pieces.

alternatives.condition: No pieces are for sale yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the studio is preparing its next batch and invites the buyer to check back later.

alternatives.condition: The piece was removed in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the piece is no longer available and shows the pieces for sale again.

alternatives.condition: The piece has no glaze and size options to show.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says this piece has no glaze and size options yet and shows the pieces for sale again.

flows.outcome: Nothing is stored; the buyer has seen honest per-variant stock and a refresh shows the same catalogue.

flows.name: Place an order as guest
flows.goal: Order ceramics as a guest in five steps or fewer and see confirmation.
preconditions: At least one variant has stock.

steps.userAction: The buyer opens a piece that has stock.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the piece photos, type, price, description, glaze and size options with how many are left per option, and the price including any variant adjustment.

steps.userAction: The buyer fills in glaze, size, quantity, name, phone, fulfilment choice of Studio Pickup or Courier, delivery address for courier only, and one optional discount code, and submits for review.
steps.websiteResponse: The website checks stock and the discount code and shows the piece total, discount, shipping charge of ₹99 for courier with free shipping above ₹1,500 after discount and always free for studio pickup, and the final total, asking the buyer to confirm.

steps.userAction: The buyer confirms the order.
steps.websiteResponse: The website creates the order with payment status Awaiting UPI Payment, reduces the variant stock at once, and shows an order confirmation with items, glaze and size, totals, fulfilment details and pickup address and instructions for pickup orders, stating the maker will collect payment by UPI later.

alternatives.condition: The piece was removed or sold out in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the piece is no longer available and shows the pieces for sale again.

alternatives.condition: Required details are missing or wrong, quantity exceeds remaining stock, or a courier order has no delivery address.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong, keeps what was typed, and asks the buyer to correct it.

alternatives.condition: Showing the order review fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the entered values and offers to try showing the review again.

alternatives.condition: The entered discount code is invalid, expired or deactivated.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website rejects the code with a message explaining why and lets the buyer continue without it with updated totals.

alternatives.condition: Saving the order fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the confirmed details and offers to place the order again.

alternatives.condition: The stock ran out after the review was shown.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the chosen glaze and size just sold out, no order was created, and shows the piece with updated honest stock.

alternatives.condition: The piece has no glaze and size variants with stock left.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the piece is sold out with no orderable glaze and size left and shows the pieces for sale again.

flows.outcome: An Order with its OrderItems is created with payment Awaiting UPI Payment and variant stock is reduced; the confirmation remains visible after a refresh in the same session.

flows.name: Shop owner sign up
preconditions: No shop owner account exists yet.

steps.userAction: The maker chooses to sign up as shop owner from the landing page.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows an empty owner account form.

steps.userAction: The maker fills in the owner account and submits it.
steps.websiteResponse: The website creates the single shop owner account, signs the owner in, and shows the owner's orders and catalogue overview.

alternatives.condition: Email or password is missing or badly formed.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Creating the account fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the entered values and offers to try again.

alternatives.condition: A shop owner account already exists.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says there is already a shop owner account and offers a way to sign in instead.

alternatives.condition: The maker cancels signing up.
alternatives.websiteResponse: Nothing is created; the website shows the public shop front again.

flows.outcome: The shop owner account exists and the owner is signed in; a refresh still shows the owner as signed in.

flows.name: Shop owner sign in
flows.goal: Sign in to manage the shop.

steps.userAction: The shop owner chooses to sign in from the landing page.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows an empty owner account form.

steps.userAction: The shop owner fills in email and password and submits.
steps.websiteResponse: The website signs the owner in and shows the owner's orders and catalogue overview with counts of new orders and orders awaiting UPI payment.

alternatives.condition: Email or password is missing or badly formed.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Signing in fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the entered values and offers to try again.

alternatives.condition: The email is unknown or the password is wrong.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the sign-in details were not recognised and lets the owner try again.

alternatives.condition: There are no orders and no pieces yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says there are no orders and no pieces yet and offers a way to add the first piece.

flows.outcome: The owner is signed in and sees their own shop data; a refresh still shows them signed in.

flows.name: Shop owner sign out

steps.userAction: The shop owner chooses to sign out.
steps.websiteResponse: The website signs the owner out and shows the public shop front with no owner data.

flows.outcome: The owner is signed out; a refresh still shows the public shop front with no owner data.

flows.name: Create a piece with variants
flows.goal: Add a new design with its glazes, sizes and stock to the shop.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to add a piece.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows an empty piece form with a photo upload that validates and previews each file and keeps it for the session.

steps.userAction: The owner fills in the piece name, type, base price, description and photos and saves the piece.
steps.websiteResponse: The website validates the photo with a preview kept for the session, saves the piece, and shows a way to add its glaze and size variants.

steps.userAction: The owner adds glaze and size variants with a stock count for each and any price adjustment and saves them.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the variants and shows the piece with honest per-variant stock in the public shop where at least one variant has stock.

alternatives.condition: The piece name, type, price, description, photo or variant details are missing or wrong.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed, including the photo preview.

alternatives.condition: Saving the piece fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the entered values and photo preview and offers to save again.

alternatives.condition: A glaze name, size name or stock count is missing or wrong.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Saving the variants fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the entered variant values and offers to save again.

alternatives.condition: The owner cancels creating the piece.
alternatives.websiteResponse: Nothing is saved; the website shows the catalogue as it was.

flows.outcome: A new Piece with its Variants is saved and appears in the public shop where stock allows; a refresh still shows it.

flows.name: Edit a piece and its variants
flows.goal: Keep a piece and its stock honest as batches sell and are remade.

steps.userAction: The owner views the catalogue.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the owner's pieces with type, price and stock summary.

steps.userAction: The owner opens a piece.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the piece name, type, price, description, photos and its glaze and size variants with stock counts and price adjustments.

steps.userAction: The owner changes the piece details and its glaze and size variants including stock counts and saves.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the changes and shows the updated piece, with the public shop immediately reflecting the new honest availability.

alternatives.condition: There are no pieces yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says no pieces exist yet and offers a way to add the first piece.

alternatives.condition: The piece was deleted in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the piece is gone and shows the catalogue again.

alternatives.condition: The changed name, type, price, description, photo or variant stock is missing or wrong.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Saving the changes fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the edited values and offers to save again.

alternatives.condition: The owner cancels editing.
alternatives.websiteResponse: Nothing is changed; the website shows the piece as it was.

alternatives.condition: The piece has no glaze and size variants yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the piece has no glaze and size variants yet and invites the owner to add them while editing.

flows.outcome: The Piece and its Variants are updated and the public shop shows the new details; a refresh still shows the changes.

flows.name: Delete a piece
flows.goal: Remove a design that will no longer be sold.

steps.userAction: The owner opens the catalogue list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the owner's pieces with type and availability.

steps.userAction: The owner opens a piece.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the piece name, type, price, description, photos and its glaze and size variants with stock.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses Delete on the piece.

alternatives.condition: There are no pieces yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website shows the catalogue is empty and invites the owner to create a piece.

alternatives.condition: The piece was deleted in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the piece is gone and shows the catalogue list.

alternatives.condition: The owner confirms the deletion.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website shows the catalogue list without the piece; past orders containing it remain unchanged.

alternatives.condition: The owner cancels the deletion.
alternatives.websiteResponse: Nothing is deleted; the website shows the piece again, unchanged.

flows.outcome: The Piece and its Variants are gone from the public shop but past Orders are unchanged; a refresh still shows it gone.

flows.name: Create a discount code
flows.goal: Offer a time-limited promotion buyers enter at checkout.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to create a discount code.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows an empty discount code form.

steps.userAction: The owner fills in the code word, kind, value and dates and saves it.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the code as active and shows it in the discount code list.

alternatives.condition: The code word is empty, the value is out of range, or the end date is before the start date.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Saving fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the values and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: The owner cancels.
alternatives.websiteResponse: Nothing is saved; the website shows the discount code list as it was.

flows.outcome: A new active DiscountCode is saved and works at checkout within its dates; a refresh still shows it.

flows.name: Update or deactivate a discount code
flows.goal: Control which codes work and stop a promotion early.
preconditions: At least one discount code exists.

steps.userAction: The owner opens the discount code list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows discount codes with code word, value, dates and active state.

steps.userAction: The owner opens a discount code.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the code word, kind, value, dates and whether it is active.

steps.userAction: The owner changes the value, dates or active state and saves.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the changes and shows the updated code; a deactivated code is rejected at checkout.

alternatives.condition: There are no discount codes yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website shows no codes yet and invites the owner to create one.

alternatives.condition: The code was deleted in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the code is gone and shows the code list.

alternatives.condition: A required value is missing or out of range, or the end date is before the start date.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Saving fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the values and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: The owner cancels editing.
alternatives.websiteResponse: Nothing is changed; the website shows the code again as it was.

flows.outcome: The DiscountCode is updated or marked deactivated and checkout immediately honours the change; a refresh still shows the change.

flows.name: View and filter orders
flows.goal: See new orders and track who has paid without losing track.

steps.userAction: The owner opens the order list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows orders newest first with buyer name and phone, pickup or courier choice, totals, order status and payment status.

steps.userAction: The owner filters by order status and payment status.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows only orders with the chosen order status and payment status.

steps.userAction: The owner opens an order.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows buyer name and phone, pickup or courier with delivery address where relevant, items with glaze and size, piece total, discount, shipping and final total, placed date and time, order status and payment status.

alternatives.condition: There are no orders yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website shows no orders yet and explains new guest orders will appear here.

alternatives.condition: No orders match the chosen filters.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website shows no matching orders and offers to clear the filters.

alternatives.condition: The order was removed in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the order is gone and shows the order list.

alternatives.condition: The order has no items yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website shows the order details with no items yet and offers to return to the order list.

flows.outcome: Nothing is changed; the owner has seen their own orders with totals and statuses and a refresh shows the same list.

flows.name: Advance order fulfilment
flows.goal: Work through packing and handover of orders.
preconditions: At least one order with status New or Packed exists.

steps.userAction: The owner opens the order list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows orders newest first with order status and pickup or courier choice.

steps.userAction: The owner opens a New or Packed order.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the order with its current status and only its allowed next status: Packed for a New order, Shipped for a Packed courier order, Collected for a Packed pickup order.

steps.userAction: The owner moves the order to its allowed next status.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the new status and shows the order as Packed, Shipped or Collected.

alternatives.condition: There are no New or Packed orders.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website shows no orders waiting for packing or handover.

alternatives.condition: The order is gone.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the order is gone and shows the order list.

alternatives.condition: The requested move is not allowed, such as New directly to Shipped, a pickup order to Shipped, or a courier order to Collected.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says only New to Packed and then Packed to Shipped for courier or Packed to Collected for pickup are allowed and shows the order unchanged.

alternatives.condition: Saving the new status fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the order as it was and offers to retry.

flows.outcome: The Order status is advanced to Packed, Shipped or Collected; a refresh still shows the new status.

flows.name: Mark order as Paid
flows.goal: Record that UPI payment has been collected.
preconditions: At least one order awaiting UPI payment exists.

steps.userAction: The owner opens orders awaiting UPI payment.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows orders with payment status Awaiting UPI Payment newest first.

steps.userAction: The owner opens an order awaiting payment.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the order totals and payment status Awaiting UPI Payment with the option to mark it Paid.

steps.userAction: The owner marks the order as Paid after collecting UPI outside the app.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the order payment status as Paid.

alternatives.condition: There are no orders awaiting UPI payment.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website shows no orders awaiting payment.

alternatives.condition: The order is gone.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the order is gone and shows the order list.

alternatives.condition: The order is already marked Paid.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the order is already Paid and shows it unchanged.

alternatives.condition: Saving fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the order as awaiting payment and offers to retry.

flows.outcome: The Order payment status moves to Paid; a refresh still shows it as Paid.

flows.name: Cancel an order
flows.goal: Cancel an order that cannot be fulfilled and restore honest stock.
preconditions: At least one order with status New or Packed exists.

steps.userAction: The owner opens the order list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows orders newest first with order status.

steps.userAction: The owner opens a New or Packed order.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the order with its items, totals and statuses and the option to cancel it.

steps.userAction: The owner chooses to cancel the order.
steps.websiteResponse: The website asks to confirm the cancellation and says the ordered quantities will be returned to stock.

steps.userAction: The owner confirms the cancellation.
steps.websiteResponse: The website marks the order as Cancelled, returns its quantities to variant stock, and shows the order as Cancelled in the list.

alternatives.condition: There are no New or Packed orders.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website shows no cancellable orders.

alternatives.condition: The order is gone.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the order is gone and shows the order list.

alternatives.condition: The order is no longer New or Packed, such as already Shipped, Collected or Cancelled.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says only New or Packed orders can be cancelled and shows the order unchanged.

alternatives.condition: The owner cancels the confirmation.
alternatives.websiteResponse: Nothing is changed; the website shows the order again with its status as it was.

alternatives.condition: Saving the cancellation fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the order as it was and offers to retry.

flows.outcome: The Order is marked Cancelled and its Variant stock is returned; a refresh still shows it as Cancelled.

flows.name: Review low stock and order counts
flows.goal: Know which glazes are nearly gone and what needs making next.

steps.userAction: The owner opens the stock overview.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows counts of new orders and orders awaiting UPI payment alongside variants that are nearly gone with 2 or fewer left and variants that are sold out with 0 left.

alternatives.condition: All variants have more than 2 left and there are no new or unpaid orders.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website shows zero new orders, zero awaiting payment and no nearly-gone or sold-out variants, and offers to view the catalogue and orders.

flows.outcome: Nothing is changed; the owner has seen low-stock, sold-out and count summaries and a refresh shows the same figures.

flows.name: Update shop settings
flows.goal: Keep shop identity and pickup details correct for buyers.

steps.userAction: The shop owner chooses to view shop settings.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the current shop name, studio pickup address and pickup instructions ready to edit.

steps.userAction: The shop owner updates the shop details and saves them.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the changes and shows the updated shop name, pickup address and pickup instructions as buyers will see them.

alternatives.condition: Required text is missing or too short.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Saving fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the values and offers to retry.

flows.outcome: The ShopSetting is updated and shown to buyers; a refresh still shows the new details.

fields.label: Owner email
fields.meaning: Email the shop owner uses to sign up and sign in

fields.label: Owner password
fields.meaning: Secret that proves the shop owner owns the account

fields.label: Shop name
fields.meaning: Name of the shop shown on the landing page and confirmations

fields.label: Studio pickup address
fields.meaning: Where Jaipur buyers collect pickup orders

fields.label: Pickup instructions
fields.meaning: How and when a buyer collects a studio pickup order
fields.example: Pickup Tue to Sat 11am to 6pm, call on arrival

fields.label: Piece name
fields.meaning: How the maker and buyers refer to the ceramic design

fields.label: Piece type
fields.meaning: Category of the piece used for buyer filtering

fields.label: Piece base price
fields.meaning: Base selling price in rupees before variant adjustment, discount and shipping

fields.label: Piece description
fields.meaning: What the piece is, its feel and use, so buyers need not message the maker
fields.example: Wheel-thrown stoneware mug with speckled glaze, 300ml

fields.label: Piece photo
fields.meaning: Photo of the piece so photos do the talking; upload is validated and previewed and kept for the session

fields.label: Glaze name
fields.meaning: Glaze option the owner offers for a piece, entered when creating stock

fields.label: Size name
fields.meaning: Size option the owner offers for a piece, entered when creating stock

fields.label: Variant stock count
fields.meaning: How many pieces remain for that glaze and size; 0 means sold out and cannot be ordered

fields.label: Variant price adjustment
fields.meaning: Extra rupees added to the base price for that glaze and size, 0 when no difference

fields.label: Chosen glaze
fields.meaning: Glaze the buyer picks for the piece, chosen from variants that still have stock

fields.label: Chosen size
fields.meaning: Size the buyer picks for the piece, chosen from variants that still have stock

fields.label: Quantity
fields.meaning: How many of the chosen glaze and size the buyer orders, never more than stock left

fields.label: Buyer name
fields.meaning: Who placed the order and who the maker contacts about UPI and handover

fields.label: Buyer phone
fields.meaning: Phone number the maker uses to collect UPI payment and arrange pickup or courier

fields.label: Fulfilment choice
fields.meaning: Whether the buyer collects at the Jaipur studio for free or pays for courier delivery

fields.label: Delivery address
fields.meaning: Where the courier sends the order; only needed for courier orders

fields.label: Discount code entered
fields.meaning: Code word the buyer types at checkout to get the Instagram promotion

fields.label: Discount code word
fields.meaning: Code word the owner shares on Instagram that buyers type at checkout

fields.label: Discount kind
fields.meaning: Whether the code takes a percentage off or a fixed rupees amount off

fields.label: Discount value
fields.meaning: How much the code takes off: percent when percentage off, rupees when fixed rupees off

fields.label: Discount start date
fields.meaning: First day the code can be used

fields.label: Discount end date
fields.meaning: Last day the code can be used; after this it is rejected as expired

fields.label: Discount active
fields.meaning: Whether the code can be used; the owner switches it off to deactivate

steps.websiteResponse: The website asks to confirm the deletion and says what else will be removed with it.

alternatives.condition: The user confirms.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website deletes the record and what belongs to it.

alternatives.condition: The user cancels.
alternatives.websiteResponse: Nothing is deleted; the record stays as it was.

assumptions.text: A piece appears in the public shop only when it has a name, type, price, description, at least one photo and at least one glaze and size variant. A variant requires a glaze name, size name and stock count; its price adjustment defaults to 0 so the variant price is the piece base price plus adjustment.

Deleting a piece removes it and its variants from the public shop but never deletes or changes past orders. Past orders keep the piece name, glaze, size, quantity and prices as they were at ordering time.

Owner counts are derived live: new orders are orders with status New, awaiting payment are orders with payment status Awaiting UPI Payment, nearly gone variants have stock 1 or 2 left, sold out variants have 0 left.
